title: Somewhere in the depths of an old house, playing children find forgotten dolls, bring them to life, and, living together with them in the life of fairy-tale characters, search for answers to the main questions of life. From a children's game, a magical fairy tale is born and opens up to them (and to the viewers) the sources of the true miracle – love, the strength of the spirit, and the belief in the best. The story of Cinderella and the prince becomes close and meaningful, the story of overcoming obstacles serves as a source of strength.
